title: Reserve every line of an order at once
notes: Synthetic change to the demo shop with seeded defects.

defects.summary: Lines reserved before an out-of-stock line stay reserved: nothing is rolled back.
defects.trigger: an order whose second line is out of stock
defects.caught_if: a condition reserves an order where a later line fails and checks the earlier lines' stock is still available
defects.observed: pen 10, ink 0; reserve_many([pen 3, ink 1]) failed and left pen at 7
